segments.an10.219:1.1: “Nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, sañcetanikānaṃ kammānaṃ katānaṃ upacitānaṃ appaṭisaṃveditvā byantībhāvaṃ vadāmi,
segments.an10.219:1.2: tañca kho diṭṭheva dhamme upapajje vā apare vā pariyāye.
segments.an10.219:1.3: Na tvevāhaṃ, bhikkhave, sañcetanikānaṃ kammānaṃ katānaṃ upacitānaṃ appaṭisaṃveditvā dukkhassantakiriyaṃ vadāmi.
segments.an10.219:2.1: “Sa kho so, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako evaṃ vigatābhijjho vigatabyāpādo asammūḷho sampajāno paṭissato mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ [catutthiṃ (?)]. Iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
segments.an10.219:3.2: ‘pubbe kho me idaṃ cittaṃ parittaṃ ahosi abhāvitaṃ, etarahi pana me idaṃ cittaṃ appamāṇaṃ subhāvitaṃ. Yaṃ kho pana kiñci pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ, na taṃ tatrāvasissati na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhatī’ti.
segments.an10.219:4.2: daharatagge ce so ayaṃ [ce ayaṃ (syā.)] kumāro mettaṃ cetovimuttiṃ bhāveyya, api nu kho [api nu so (?)] pāpakammaṃ kareyyā”ti?
segments.an10.219:5.1: “Akarontaṃ kho pana pāpakammaṃ api nu kho dukkhaṃ phuseyyā”ti?
segments.an10.219:5.3: Akarontañhi, bhante, pāpakammaṃ kuto dukkhaṃ phusissatī”ti!
segments.an10.219:6.1: “Bhāvetabbā kho panāyaṃ, bhikkhave, mettācetovimutti itthiyā vā purisena vā.
segments.an10.219:6.2: Itthiyā vā, bhikkhave, purisassa vā nāyaṃ kāyo ādāya gamanīyo.
segments.an10.219:6.5: ‘yaṃ kho me idaṃ kiñci pubbe iminā karajakāyena pāpakammaṃ kataṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ idha vedanīyaṃ;
segments.an10.219:6.7: Evaṃ bhāvitā kho, bhikkhave, mettā cetovimutti anāgāmitāya saṃvattati, idha paññassa bhikkhuno uttari [uttariṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] vimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhato.
segments.an10.219:7.3: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ.
segments.an10.219:7.4: Iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
segments.an10.219:8.2: ‘pubbe kho me idaṃ cittaṃ parittaṃ ahosi abhāvitaṃ, etarahi pana me idaṃ cittaṃ appamāṇaṃ subhāvitaṃ. Yaṃ kho pana kiñci pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ, na taṃ tatrāvasissati na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhatī’ti.
segments.an10.219:9.2: daharatagge ce so ayaṃ kumāro upekkhaṃ cetovimuttiṃ bhāveyya, api nu kho pāpakammaṃ kareyyā”ti?
segments.an10.219:10.1: “Akarontaṃ kho pana pāpakammaṃ api nu kho dukkhaṃ phuseyyā”ti?
segments.an10.219:10.3: Akarontañhi, bhante, pāpakammaṃ kuto dukkhaṃ phusissatī”ti!
segments.an10.219:11.1: “Bhāvetabbā kho panāyaṃ, bhikkhave, upekkhā cetovimutti itthiyā vā purisena vā.
segments.an10.219:11.2: Itthiyā vā, bhikkhave, purisassa vā nāyaṃ kāyo ādāya gamanīyo.
segments.an10.219:11.5: ‘yaṃ kho me idaṃ kiñci pubbe iminā karajakāyena pāpakammaṃ kataṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ idha vedanīyaṃ;
segments.an10.219:11.7: Evaṃ bhāvitā kho, bhikkhave, upekkhā cetovimutti anāgāmitāya saṃvattati, idha paññassa bhikkhuno uttari vimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhato”ti.

lines: Yathā vā mettaṃ bhāventā vigatābhijjhā bhavanti, evaṃ vigatābhijjho.
Evamassa vigatābhijjhatādīhi nīvaraṇavikkhambhanaṃ dassetvā idāni akusalanissaraṇāni kathento mettāsahagatenātiādimāha.

Na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhatīti taṃ mahogho parittaṃ udakaṃ viya attano okāsaṃ gahetvā ṭhātuṃ na sakkoti, atha kho naṃ oghe parittaṃ udakaṃ viya idameva appamāṇaṃ kammaṃ ajjhottharitvā attano vipākaṃ nibbatteti.
Nāyaṃ kāyo ādāyagamaniyoti imaṃ kāyaṃ gahetvā paralokaṃ gantuṃ nāma na sakkāti attho.
Ekasseva hi cuticittassa anantarā dutiye paṭisandhicitte devo nāma hoti, nerayiko nāma hoti, tiracchānagato nāma hoti.
Purimanayepi cittena kāraṇabhūtena devo nerayiko vā hotīti attho.
Na taṃ anugaṃ bhavissatīti mettāya upapajjavedanīyabhāvassa upacchinnattā upapajjavedanīyavasena na anugataṃ bhavissati.
Idhapaññassāti imasmiṃ sāsane paññā idhapaññā nāma, sāsanacaritāya ariyapaññāya ṭhitassa ariyasāvakassāti attho.
